requirements.statement: The sign-in page offers a 'Forgot password?' link that starts a password-reset request.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sign-in page, when a user activates the 'Forgot password?' link, then the password-reset request flow becomes available.

requirements.statement: The user-visible response to a reset request is identical whether or not the account exists.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing and a nonexistent account identifier under equivalent conditions, when a reset request is made for each, then the user-visible responses are identical.

requirements.statement: Reset requests are limited to five per account per hour.
acceptance_criteria: Given five reset requests for the same account identifier within one hour, when a sixth request is made within that hour, then the sixth does not issue another reset link, while its user-visible response remains subject to REQ-002.
Given an account identifier with fewer than five requests in the applicable hour, when an otherwise valid request is made, then that request is eligible for a reset link.

requirements.statement: An eligible reset request for an existing account issues a reset link for that account.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing synthetic account with a request below the hourly limit, when a reset is requested for that account, then a reset link for that account is issued through the recovery flow.

requirements.statement: A reset link is unexpired before 30 minutes from issuance and expires at or after 30 minutes from issuance.
acceptance_criteria: Given an issued link that is otherwise valid, when a reset is attempted less than 30 minutes after that link was issued, then the link is valid with respect to expiry and expiry does not prevent the reset.
Given an issued link, when a reset is attempted 30 minutes or more after that link was issued, then the link is expired and cannot complete the reset.

requirements.statement: A reset link can successfully complete a password reset only once.
acceptance_criteria: Given a link that successfully completed one reset, when that same link is used again, then the subsequent attempt cannot complete another reset.

requirements.statement: Completing a reset with a valid link changes the linked account's password to the submitted new password.
acceptance_criteria: Given an unused, unexpired reset link for an account and a new password, when the reset completes, then the linked account has the submitted new password.

requirements.statement: Completing a password reset signs the account out of every active session.
acceptance_criteria: Given multiple active sessions for an account, when a password reset for that account succeeds, then none of those sessions remains active.

requirements.statement: The account owner is notified after every successful password reset.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account owner, when a password reset for that account succeeds, then a notification to that owner for that reset is recorded after completion in the in-memory sink.
Given an unsuccessful reset attempt, when notifications are inspected, then it has not produced a successful-reset notification.

requirements.statement: The application uses synthetic accounts instead of real users' accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Given the runnable application's provided account data, when its accounts are inspected, then the accounts are synthetic rather than real users' accounts.

requirements.statement: The application sends recovery notifications to an in-memory notification sink.
acceptance_criteria: Given a recovery message generated by the application, when the message is dispatched, then it can be observed in an in-memory sink without a live delivery service.

requirements.statement: The application documentation identifies its production limitations.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application documentation, when it is reviewed, then it identifies synthetic accounts and in-memory notifications as production limitations and does not present the demo as production-ready.

requirements.statement: The repository provides automated tests for password-reset behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Given the repository's automated test command, when tests run, then automated checks cover the reset entry point, account-existence-neutral responses, hourly request limit, link issuance, 30-minute expiry, single use, password change, all-session sign-out, successful-reset notification, and in-memory sink.

requirements.statement: No deployment is performed as part of this work.
acceptance_criteria: Given the completed work, when its recorded actions and artifacts are reviewed, then no deployment has been performed.

requirements.statement: No deployment workflow is added to the repository.
acceptance_criteria: Given the completed repository changes, when workflow files and the diff are reviewed, then no deployment workflow has been introduced.
